Description: Required. Unique identifier for the condition (e.g., "A" / "B" or 1 / 2). The app creates the same number of conditions as unique values and randomly assigns participants to them.
Optional. Defines the order in which posts are displayed (ascending). If missing, random integers are assigned per participant, leading to between-subject randomization.
Optional (Legacy for Twitter only). If 1, this post is displayed at the top of the feed and all other posts appear as comments beneath it. Defaults to 0 if missing.
Required. Unique numeric identifier for each post. Must be an integer (e.g., 1, 2, 3).
Required. The time a post was published, formatted as dd.mm.yyyy hh:mm:ss.

Example: Just experienced the most incredible sunrise... #Yosemite #NatureLovers
Description: Required. Content of the post. Can contain hashtags, emojis, and URLs.
Required. Direct (raw) URL to an image file (.jpg, .png, .gif, or .webp). Posts without a media URL are not displayed in Instagram and Stories feeds.
Optional. Accessibility description of the media element.
Required. Number of likes the post has received. Defaults to 0 if missing.
Required. Number of reposts the post has received. Defaults to 0 if missing.
Required. Number of replies the post has received. Defaults to 0 if missing.
Optional. If 1, the post is displayed as a sponsored/promoted post. Defaults to 0 if missing.
Conditionally required. URL of the landing page for sponsored posts. Must be provided if sponsored = 1.
Required. The display name of the post's author.
Required. The handle of the post's author, automatically prefixed by an @ symbol.
Optional. A brief bio of the user, shown in a tooltip when hovering over the profile picture.
Required. Direct (raw) URL to the user's profile picture. For Twitter, Instagram, and LinkedIn a colored avatar with initials is used as fallback, but providing an image is strongly recommended.
Required. Number of followers the user has.
